title: Room Rate Retained When a Resort Lodging Party Leaves Early
content:
The room rate retained when a Resort Lodging party leaves before the departure date on the reservation is worked out on the nights of the stay the party gave up, each of them priced at the nightly rate of the published window the stay falls in, and the whole of it is retained. The nights given up are counted as the nights the reservation covers less the nights the folio shows consumed where a departure is recorded on the reservation, and where no departure is recorded on the reservation no night of the stay counts as given up. The amounts are carried at full precision and the entry posted to the folio is rounded to the nearest cent once, at the end. An amount that falls exactly halfway between two cents is rounded to the cent whose last digit is even, which is the convention the collective's finance office settles every folio on.

**The room rate retained.** The nightly rate the retained nights are priced at is multiplied by the number of nights retained to give the room rate retained.

### A worked retention (hypothetical figures)

Take a reservation covering 7 nights whose folio shows 4 nights consumed and on which a departure is recorded. The nights the reservation covers less the nights the folio shows consumed give 3 nights given up. Where the nightly rate the retained nights are priced at is taken here as 400.00 USD and 3 nights are retained, the room rate retained is 400.00 USD multiplied by 3 nights, which is 1200.00 USD, and the whole of that is retained. Carried at full precision and rounded to the nearest cent once, at the end, the entry posted to the folio is 1200.00 USD.
